description: The Gulf Shores Museum offers free admission to the public and features a variety of exhibits exploring the history and culture of Gulf Shores. The museum also features rotating exhibits and special exhibits that can range from human interest stories to exhibits on loan from various institutions. Programs and events occur throughout the year and vary depending on holiday, event, or demand from the audience.

description:
Brian and Jodi Harsany’s interpretation with this unique restaurant affords local and visitors the opportunity to experience coastal cuisine at its finest. Chef Reed Moody, Executive Chef, loves to cook and this love started him in the kitchen at a young age. He attended Faulkner State and studied Culinary Arts. In his role as Executive Chef he looks forward to continuing Cobalt’s tradition of great food along the Gulf Coast and also expanding our reach with the use of fresh and local ingredients.

Chef Nick Norman, Chef de Cuisine, is a Pensacola native and has been with us since 2012. He loves experimenting with Latin cuisine and cultivating these elements into the dishes here at Cobalt. In addition, he loves the challenge of alcohol and food fusion with unique pairings and intense flavor profiles.

Chef Rush Golden, Sous Chef, has been with our family of restaurants for the last nine years, mostly recently at GTs On The Bay. His love of Southern cooking puts a spin on Gulf Coast favorites and we are excited to have him here at Cobalt. He enjoys the restaurant business because there’s always something new to learn and he is constantly thinking of ways he can improve.

Chef Jeffrey Palmer, Sous Chef, has been with us since 2018. He became one of our Sous Chefs in 2022. description: Just steps from the sands of Gulf Shores Public Beach, The Catch Seafood Grill and Bar is where amazing food, unforgettable cocktails, good company, and the sound of the Gulf come together. Whether you're here for a beach day bite, dinner with friends, or a relaxing cocktail at the bar or on our patio during sunset, we're ready to serve something memorable. Located right across from Gulf Shores Public Beach and just minutes from Orange Beach and Foley, we're easy to find and even easier to love. At The Catch, we believe great seafood starts right here at home. Our menu is built around the freshest wild-caught Gulf shrimp and seafood, paired with the bold, comforting flavors the Gulf Coast is known for. Our signature seafood boils are a true Gulf feast piled high with crab legs, Gulf shrimp, mussels, Conecuh sausage, corn on the cob, and red potatoes, all tossed in our bold, house-made garlic butter sauces you won't find anywhere else. Craving something crispy? Try our fried shrimp or fried fish platters, served golden with hushpuppies, creamy coleslaw, and fried okra. Looking for something a little indulgent? Don't miss our Garlic Butter Spiny Lobster or grilled salmon plates, both served with mashed potatoes and fresh grilled veggies. Or dig into guest favorites like the Bayou Crawfish Pasta or our Southern-style crab cakes, packed with Gulf flavor and made to be remembered. Our full bar features a wide selection of signature cocktails, frozen daiquiris, and local favorites perfect for sipping under the sun or catching golden hour by the water. Every drink is crafted with you in mind from bold, refreshing flavors to classic favorites that complement your beach day, lunch, or sunset dinner. Gulf Shores is known for family vacations, reunions, bridal trips, and sporting celebrations, and we've made sure there's room for everyone at The Catch. Stop by solo, bring a meeting of friends, or gather the whole team we're built for every kind of celebration. With spacious indoor dining, a lively full bar area, and breezy patio seating perfect for larger groups, The Catch is the ultimate stop for family meals, group celebrations, or a casual bite after a day at the beach.

description: Sarah and Tater Harris met on a summer's day in Lima, Peru, in 2010. Soon after, they embarked on a journey together to Tater's home state of Alabama, where they instantly fell in love with the charm of Orange Beach—its stunning coastline, incredible dining, and the vibrant, growing community. Five years later, they tied the knot and spent the next nine years traveling and living across the United States. Their adventures took them to places like the Caribbean, Chicago, Illinois, Ann Arbor, Michigan, Northern California, Lake Charles, Louisiana, Chattanooga, Tennessee, and Beaumont, Texas, among others. In 2016, after purchasing their first Polaris Slingshot, they discovered the thrill and freedom of open-air cruising. Wanting to share this exhilarating experience with others, they decided to start a rental business offering Polaris Slingshots, Jeep Wranglers, LSVs, and beach and baby equipment. With a commitment to providing an unforgettable experience, they set their prices to ensure both tourists and locals could enjoy a five-star adventure without breaking the bank. The idea for beach and baby equipment rental came later. While taking a vacation to Hawaii both Sarah and Tater noticed all of the rental companies that provided numerous items to the tourist that visited there. They realized that their own home town where they had kept their permanent address had no such place and was in need of a company that offered high quality beach and baby equipment at a great price. They also added overflow parking for all of the tourist and locals alike that are in need of additional parking in the season as well as the off season. Sarah, Tater and their son Jay are extremely thankful to be able to provide a five-star experience with high quality equipment for everyone to enjoy. They are looking forward to being here for our beloved tourist and amazing locals for years to come.
